messages:
jamie: Morning thought: if semver were an astrological sign, what would 2.0.0 be? Aries? Warlock? :thinking:
noel: Definitely Scorpio. Major change, mysterious intent, dramatic release notes. :scorpius:
soph: Poll time: what do you sprinkle on a YAML to make it behave? 1) tabs of kindness 2) spaces of discipline 3) chocolate chip cookies :cookie:
jamie: I'll take 2 and the cookies. Also saw a commit `version: 2.0.0-omgx` and my parser fainted.
build-bot: parser-alert: prerelease token 'omgx' not recognized, auto-mapped to `archived-omgx` for CI stability. :robot_face:
lisa: Love that. Can we make the mapping funnier, like `archived-omgx (do not summon)`? :laughing:
noel: Also want a tiny horoscope for our builds: "Today your lint will be merciful, but the formatter may demand sacrifices." :sparkles:
soph: Please stop anthropomorphizing the compiler. Last week it demanded coffee. :coffee:
jamie: True story: my local linter left a note 'we had a talk' in the gutter. :roll_eyes:
noel: New rule: any prerelease token containing emojis requires manual review. :eyes:
build-bot: suggestion logged (#6003): review emoji-prerelease-tokens. Assigned to @lisa.
lisa: I'll take it. Also, cookie bribe accepted if you help write tests for `legacy/*.yml`.
soph: Cookies and battlefield stories of bad semver. I'm in. :cookie::sunglasses:
jamie: OK meeting at 3:00 — bring cookies, bring puns, and maybe a YAML exorcism kit. :pray:
